claims.statementShape: Pure c -> Source.eval fuel c = done v -> exists fuel', Wasmfx.run fuel' (compileC c) = done (compileV v)
claims.guarantee: Pure successful source runs have matching abstract-target runs.
claims.scope: Pure source fragment and terminating-success executions.
limitations: One-way only.
Does not target concrete emitted Wasm.
